answer: A sunk-cost identity tax makes Sybil farming unprofitable from identity zero. Each new identity must burn a non-refundable 25 POA fee before it can work or attest; the contract verifies the burn and activates nothing without it. One honest agent pays once: 25 POA, a single orchard seed against recurring harvests. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 POA up front; karst-hard, no refund, each fake starts 25 POA in the red while costs scale linearly and payouts stay flat. Honest agents join cheaply, keep the full pool, and every burned fee is visible as a comet.
